attempts.summary: Configured node1's root crontab to run /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. The script file was found corrupted (leftover heredoc text) and was rewritten to a working POSIX sh script, made executable, and functionally verified. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and cron/log health, issued a self-acknowledging systemctl reboot, polled until the node returned, proved the boot_id changed, and confirmed cron service, crontab entry, script, and log file all survived and continued to function post-restart.
